section: Social sector initiatives in AP - education, health, nutrition and their outcome indicators
subsections: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting
Digital health - ABDM rank, health record linkage

accepted.s: Under Dr NTR Vaidya Seva, which of the following correctly describes the income eligibility and annual coverage?
o: Only BPL families, with coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year
All families irrespective of income, with coverage of ₹25 lakh per family per year
Families with income up to ₹2 lakh and coverage of ₹10 lakh per family
BPL families and families with income up to ₹5 lakh, with coverage of ₹25 lakh per family per year
accepted.x: Dr NTR Vaidya Seva covers BPL families and families with annual income up to ₹5 lakh, providing cover of ₹25 lakh per family per year.
accepted.tq: Split the options by checking both the income ceiling and the coverage amount.

accepted.s:
With reference to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva, consider the following statements:
1. There is no limit on the annual cover for cancer treatment.
2. The scheme covers 3,257 procedures.
3. It benefited 1.43 crore families according to APSES 2024-25.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: cancer treatment has no cover limit, 3,257 procedures are covered, and 1.43 crore families benefited according to APSES 2024-25.
accepted.tq: Use the numerical cluster and verify each statement independently.

accepted.s: During June–December 2025, Dr NTR Vaidya Seva recorded which of the following figures?
o: 1.43 crore patients treated and ₹2,723 crore in claims
11.36 lakh patients treated and ₹2,723 crore in claims
9.22 lakh patients treated and ₹4,000 crore in claims
11.36 lakh patients treated and ₹9,668 crore in claims
accepted.x: During June–December 2025, 11.36 lakh patients were treated and claims amounted to ₹2,723 crore.
accepted.tq: Match the period with its treatment and claims figures.

accepted.s: In March 2026, which addition was made to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva?
accepted.x: Five cardiac procedures were added to Dr NTR Vaidya Seva in March 2026.
accepted.tq: Test the specific service addition rather than the broader scheme coverage.

accepted.s: The Universal Health Policy announced in 2026 provides free treatment up to which amount per citizen through insurers?
accepted.x: The Universal Health Policy provides free treatment up to ₹2.5 lakh per citizen through insurers.
accepted.tq: Separate the individual limit under the Universal Health Policy from the higher Vaidya Seva limit.

accepted.s: Under the Universal Health Policy, which institution covers poor persons beyond the insurer-provided limit?
o: The Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust
accepted.x: The Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust covers poor persons beyond ₹2.5 lakh, up to ₹25 lakh.
accepted.tq: Use the ‘who covers the excess’ approach to distinguish institutions.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the rural and urban Primary Health Centre network in Andhra Pradesh according to SES 2025-26?
accepted.x: The network comprised 1,293 rural PHCs and 559 urban PHCs.
accepted.tq: Check the rural–urban labels instead of merely recognising the numbers.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the health facility network in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There were 10,032 Village Health Clinics.
2. There were 11,086 sub-centres.
3. There were 173 Community Health Centres and 54 area hospitals.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly state the reported numbers of Village Health Clinics, sub-centres, CHCs and area hospitals.
accepted.tq: Group the facility figures and verify each category separately.

accepted.s: The Family Physician concept in Andhra Pradesh envisages that PHC doctors should:
o: Manage only private hospitals in villages
Visit village health clinics on fixed days
accepted.x: Under the Family Physician concept, PHC doctors visit village health clinics on fixed days.
accepted.tq: Identify the operational meaning of the service concept.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding emergency and mobile health services in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. The State had 768 ambulances under the 108 service.
2. These ambulances carried 9.22 lakh patients in 2024-25.
3. The State also had 104 Mobile Medical Units.
accepted.x: The 108 service had 768 ambulances, carried 9.22 lakh patients in 2024-25, and operated alongside 104 Mobile Medical Units.
accepted.tq: Combine service count, outcome count and facility count without swapping them.

accepted.s: Under Citizen Health Screening, the 104 Mobile Medical Units now conduct how many tests a year?
accepted.x: The 104 Mobile Medical Units conduct 47 tests a year under Citizen Health Screening.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the number of tests from the service number and facility counts.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
1. Dr YSR Kanti Velugu — Eye health
2. Nadu-Nedu — School education
3. YSR Nethanna Nestham — Handloom weavers
accepted.x: Dr YSR Kanti Velugu concerns eye health, Nadu-Nedu concerns school education, and YSR Nethanna Nestham benefits handloom weavers.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and test whether the remaining pairings also belong to the same scheme list.

accepted.s: Telemedicine in Andhra Pradesh is associated with which of the following facilities?
accepted.x: Telemedicine is associated with Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres, or AB-HWCs.
accepted.tq: Identify the facility-based application rather than the implementing scheme’s general objective.

accepted.s: Talliki Vandanam, earlier known as Amma Vodi, provides which benefit?
o: ₹15,000 per student as a one-time scholarship
₹10,090 per child per year to the school
₹15,000 per child per year to the mother
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 per child per year to the mother of a child studying in a government or private school.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the beneficiary, periodicity and amount of the education benefit.

accepted.s: Talliki Vandanam was allocated ₹10,090 crore for how many students according to the reported January 2026 information?
accepted.x: An allocation of ₹10,090 crore was reported for 67.27 lakh students under Talliki Vandanam.
accepted.tq: Match the scheme allocation with its beneficiary count, not with figures from other education schemes.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with Mana Badi Mana Bhavishyathu (Nadu-Nedu)?
accepted.x: Mana Badi Mana Bhavishyathu, also called Nadu-Nedu, focuses on school infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Use objective-based discrimination among similarly named education schemes.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about Nadu-Nedu is correct?
1. ₹1,500 crore was provided for 2026-27.
2. Nadu-Nedu works worth ₹7,876 crore were left incomplete.
accepted.x: Both statements are correct: the 2026-27 provision was ₹1,500 crore and incomplete works were valued at ₹7,876 crore.
accepted.tq: Check whether the budget figure and implementation-status figure refer to the same scheme.

accepted.s:
Dokka Seethamma Madhyahna Bhojanam, formerly Jagananna Gorumudda, is characterised by which of the following?
1. It was extended to Intermediate students.
2. It covered 27.97 lakh students.
3. It provides five eggs and three chikkis a week.
accepted.x: The programme was extended to Intermediate, covered 27.97 lakh students, and provided five eggs and three chikkis per week.
accepted.tq: Test the programme’s extension, beneficiary number and nutrition entitlement together.

accepted.s: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan Vidyarthi Mitra, formerly Jagananna Vidya Kanuka, provides free:
o: Kits consisting of textbooks, uniforms, shoes and bags
Meals consisting of eggs and chikkis
accepted.x: The scheme provides free kits containing textbooks, uniforms, shoes and bags.
accepted.tq: Recognise the contents of the kit and distinguish them from meal and literacy programmes.

accepted.s: The objective of Akshara Andhra, implemented through the Adult Education Department, is:
accepted.x: Akshara Andhra aims at 100% literacy.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its stated objective rather than its department alone.

accepted.s: How many adults passed the FLNAT 2026 test under Akshara Andhra?
accepted.x: A total of 24.7 lakh adults passed the FLNAT 2026 test under Akshara Andhra.
accepted.tq: Carefully retain the decimal placement in the lakh figure.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Samagra Shiksha in Andhra Pradesh:
1. There are 352 KGBVs.
2. Seats in KGBVs are allocated 75% to SC, ST, OBC and minority students and 25% to BPL students.
3. There are 679 Bhavitha centres for children with special needs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Samagra Shiksha includes 352 KGBVs, the stated 75:25 seat distribution, and 679 Bhavitha centres.
accepted.tq: Check both composition percentages and facility counts before selecting the coded option.

accepted.s: Which programme provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis?
o: Poshana Plus exclusively for tribal children
accepted.x: Anna Amrutha Hastam provides one full meal to pregnant and lactating women at Anganwadis.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group and service together.

accepted.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana and Poshana Plus target which group?
o: Only school-going children aged 6 to 14 years
Only adolescent girls in urban areas
Only elderly persons below the poverty line
Pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6 months to 6 years, with Plus operating in tribal areas
accepted.x: The programmes cover pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6 months to 6 years; the Plus version operates in tribal areas.
accepted.tq: Use the age band and the tribal-area distinction to eliminate partial matches.

accepted.s: Balasanjeevani SNP currently covers approximately:
o: 4.15 lakh adolescent girls and 19.13 lakh school children
19.13 lakh pregnant/lactating women and 4.15 lakh children under six
4.15 lakh pregnant/lactating women and 19.13 lakh children under six
1.31 crore women and 4.15 lakh children under six
accepted.x: Balasanjeevani SNP covers 4.15 lakh pregnant and lactating women and 19.13 lakh children under six.
accepted.tq: Do not reverse the two beneficiary categories while reading paired figures.

accepted.s: Anna Canteens are primarily intended for the:
accepted.x: Anna Canteens target the urban poor.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme by its principal target group.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the Anna Canteen network?
accepted.x: There were 204 Anna Canteens in 123 Urban Local Bodies.
accepted.tq: Keep the facility count and the local-body count in their proper order.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about ICDS in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. It has 55,746 Anganwadi Centres.
2. It has 257 ICDS projects.
3. Supplementary nutrition covers 98.54% of women and 95.62% of children.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct according to the reported ICDS figures.
accepted.tq: Check the institutional counts together with the two coverage percentages.

accepted.s:
The adolescent girls scheme in Andhra Pradesh operates in which districts?
1. Alluri Sitharama Raju
2. Parvathipuram Manyam
3. YSR Kadapa
accepted.x: The adolescent girls scheme operates in Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam and YSR Kadapa districts.
accepted.tq: Use the complete district list and avoid treating the tribal-area reference as a substitute for a district name.

accepted.s: According to SRS 2021-23, which indicator shows the following Andhra Pradesh and India values respectively: 30 and 88?
accepted.x: The maternal mortality ratio was 30 in Andhra Pradesh and 88 for India.
accepted.tq: Match the paired state–national values to the correct indicator.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following SRS 2021-23 indicators of Andhra Pradesh in descending order of their reported numerical values:
A. MMR
B. IMR
C. U5MR
D. TFR
accepted.x: The values are MMR 30, U5MR 21, IMR 19 and TFR 1.5; hence the descending order is A, C, B, D.
accepted.tq: Arrange by numerical magnitude, not by the order in which the indicators are commonly named.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following is correctly matched for SRS 2021-23?
1. AP IMR — 19
2. India IMR — 25
3. AP U5MR — 21
4. India U5MR — 29
accepted.x: All four pairings are correct: AP and India recorded IMRs of 19 and 25, and U5MRs of 21 and 29 respectively.
accepted.tq: Verify each state–India pairing rather than relying on the indicator name alone.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to SRS 2021-23, the total fertility rate was:
accepted.x: The total fertility rate was 1.5 in Andhra Pradesh and 1.9 in India.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed state–national comparison.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding life expectancy according to SRS 2021-23 is correct?
o: Female life expectancy was 68.5 years in AP and 72.5 years in India.
Male life expectancy was 73.3 years in both AP and India.
Female life expectancy was 72.5 years in AP and 73.3 years in India; male life expectancy was 68.5 years only in AP.
Female life expectancy was 73.3 years in AP and 72.5 years in India; male life expectancy was 68.5 years in both.
accepted.x: Female life expectancy was 73.3 years in AP and 72.5 years in India, while male life expectancy was 68.5 years in both.
accepted.tq: Separate sex-wise values before comparing AP with India.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The earlier reported values for Andhra Pradesh were which of the following?
accepted.x: The earlier reported values were an MMR of 45 and an IMR of 24.
accepted.tq: Distinguish earlier values from the latest SRS 2021-23 values.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What percentage of adolescent girls in Andhra Pradesh were anaemic according to NFHS-5?
accepted.x: NFHS-5 reported anaemia among 60.1% of adolescent girls in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Separate the NFHS-5 estimate from the later state-screening percentage.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The state screening conducted in 2023-24 recorded anaemia among what percentage of adolescent girls in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The 2023-24 state screening recorded anaemia among 50.42% of adolescent girls.
accepted.tq: Compare the similarly worded NFHS-5 and state-screening percentages by year.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the change in child stunting reported by WDCW?
accepted.x: Child stunting declined from 21.21% to 11.15%.
accepted.tq: Read the direction of change as well as the two percentages.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the WDCW-reported changes in underweight and wasting among children?
accepted.x: Underweight declined from 9.35% to 5.90%, while wasting declined from 5.21% to 3.98%.
accepted.tq: Avoid swapping the two nutrition indicators and preserve their respective before–after values.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: NFHS-6 for 2023-24 was released on 1 June 2026 by which institution and was based on how many households?
accepted.x: NFHS-6 was released by IIPS Mumbai on 1 June 2026 and covered 6.79 lakh households.
accepted.tq: Link the release date with the issuing institution and survey size.
accepted.sec: Health outcome indicators - IMR, MMR, life expectancy, NFHS-5 anaemia and stunting  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Sanjeevani, which became statewide from August 2026 after being piloted in Chittoor and Kuppam, provides every citizen with:
o: A ration card and Aadhaar number
A school identity card and FLNAT certificate
A health insurance card limited to ₹2.5 lakh
A digital health profile and ABHA ID
accepted.x: Sanjeevani provides every citizen with a digital health profile and an ABHA ID.
accepted.tq: Distinguish digital identity and health-record functions from insurance and welfare benefits.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM rank, health record linkage  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following facilities and services are linked through the Sanjeevani Citizen Wellness App?
1. PHCs
2. Laboratories
3. e-Aushadhi
4. 108, 104 and telemedicine
accepted.x: The app links PHCs, laboratories, e-Aushadhi, 108, 104 and telemedicine.
accepted.tq: Treat the list as cumulative and select the option containing every stated linkage.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM rank, health record linkage  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement about the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission is correct?
o: It was launched in 2021 by the Women Development and Child Welfare Department.
It was launched in 2026 by the Adult Education Department.
It was launched in 2021 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
It was launched in 2014 by the Ministry of Rural Development.
accepted.x: ABDM was launched in 2021 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
accepted.tq: Use the institution–year pairing and reject ministry swaps.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM rank, health record linkage  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Universal NCD-CD screening in Andhra Pradesh has covered approximately:
accepted.x: Universal NCD-CD screening has covered 1.31 crore citizens.
accepted.tq: Pay attention to the lakh–crore scale in the coverage figure.
accepted.sec: Digital health - ABDM rank, health record linkage  [APPSC]
